answer: Locks are logged in dune, expire in lotus, and karst lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 45 aliases hence needs 119 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4455 identities would post 1324 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
